name: 2026-08-12-eval-speaker-recurring

items.text: The team is reworking memory into a two-tier system (a narrative base plus a relational base that records the reasons/context behind decisions), because the boss wants ChatGPT-style long-term memory.
An index layer over meeting notes is being built so search is efficient and cuts token cost, retrieving by index instead of feeding whole transcripts.
An evaluation harness is being built to measure memory and indexing quality; the boss elevated it to a hypothesis-driven gating discipline before shipping.
Speaker identification is context-based; the goal is good speaker suggestion so summaries and context come out accurate.
The 50MB upload limit was a Supabase free-tier cap; it was fixed by upgrading to Supabase Pro and the cap is now 200MB.
Recording is capped at 2 hours with an auto-stop-and-save at the limit.
The mobile app package is being renamed from com.example to com.tecace, with Azure auth redirects registered.
The memory feature is being extended so notes created from mobile recordings also fold into memory.
Action items should carry owner attribution (who is responsible), derived from the speaker of each commitment.
An in-app feedback / issue tracker (mini-Jira) is being built so users can report bugs.
Andrew builds all the software via Claude; Eun Seok Lee is the designer, involved only when a screen needs design.
Version tracking is automated across web, backend, MCP, and mobile.
